The '''Kwapi pirates''' were a group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] that once threatened [[Trianii Space/Legends|Trianii Space]], but were beaten back by the efforts of the [[Trianii Rangers]].<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> They originated the [[Kwapi system/Legends|Kwapi system]].<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=Kwapi pirates|system=Kwapi system|legends=1}}</ref>
